# Isabel Brouwer

> Isabel Brouwer is a Dutch entrepreneur, connector, and initiator of Healing Grounds.
> She is committed to the health of people, planet, and enterprise.
> As an international growth guide she works with founders on impactful growth —
> not as a coach, but as a guide for the business.
> She also helps health professionals articulate the essence of their practice.

## About

Isabel started her first business at 15. She studied in Utrecht, Dublin and Amsterdam,
worked five years in government, then moved into the startup and scale-up world where
she worked for years with fast-growing tech companies.

The loss of her father brought her back to what truly matters: listening to the body,
living from connection, and building something that genuinely makes the world better.
In 2023 she began building Healing Grounds. Since 2026 she integrates Go-to-Market
strategy with the energetic connection between entrepreneur and creation.

She works fluently in Dutch and English.

## Services

- Growth Guide for founders (entrepreneurs): intensive field sessions and
  Strategy & GTM guidance (6–9 months) for finding the right (international) market
- Articulating the essence of your practice: for health professionals who know what
  they do but struggle to put it into words — through deep conversation partly guided
  by meditation

## DutchBaseCamp

DutchBaseCamp was a Dutch foundation that helped Dutch startups grow internationally.
Isabel developed the Globaliser there — a programme that helped startups and scale-ups
find the right market, build a strategy for that market, and adapt their organisation
to succeed internationally. DutchBaseCamp had international networks to help founders
land in new markets; founder-to-founder learning was central. Isabel was also
responsible for business development.

## Healing Grounds

Healing Grounds is Isabel's mission-driven project, honouring the connection between
body, mind, society and earth. Website: https://www.healinggrounds.org

## Speaking

Isabel shares her perspective on the connection between body and mind — on stage,
in boardrooms, and via podcasts. She is equally comfortable in Dutch and English.
